cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(usm_re C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Statically recompiled USM.exe, generated by tools/recomp/recomp.py into src/recomp/gen (not in git: it is
# the game's code). Compiled once and shared by both builds below.
file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/recomp/gen/recomp_*.c)
if(NOT RECOMP_GEN)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "src/recomp/gen is empty: run  py tools/recomp/recomp.py src/recomp/gen all")
endif()
add_library(recomp OBJECT src/recomp/rt.c src/recomp/fpu_port.c ${RECOMP_GEN})
target_include_directories(recomp PUBLIC src/recomp src/recomp/gen)
# x87 math like the original (MSVC 7.1 emits no SSE), so the translated float code is bit-exact.
# -fixup-byte-word-insts=false: clang 23's X86FixupBWInsts turns `mov ax, [eax]` into `movzx eax, word [eax]`
# when the upper half is still live (found by difftest at 0x5efb20).
# USM_RC_PORTABLE: rehearse the Vita's float math on the PC (x87 registers as doubles, SSE2 math, fpu_port.c)
option(USM_RC_PORTABLE "x87 as doubles, like the Vita build" OFF)
if(USM_RC_PORTABLE)
    set(RC_FPU -msse2 -mfpmath=sse)
    target_compile_definitions(recomp PUBLIC RC_PORTABLE)
else()
    set(RC_FPU -mno-sse -mfpmath=387)
endif()
target_compile_options(recomp PRIVATE -std=gnu11 -w ${RC_FPU} -fno-strict-aliasing -fwrapv
    "SHELL:-mllvm -fixup-byte-word-insts=false")
# USM_RC_RELEASE: no hit counters, per-function enables or return checks (for speed; the quarantine stops working)
option(USM_RC_RELEASE "recompiled code without instrumentation" OFF)
if(USM_RC_RELEASE)
    target_compile_definitions(recomp PRIVATE RC_RELEASE)
endif()

# PC hook build: loaded by the game's ASI loader from Scripts\usm_re.asi.
add_library(usm_re SHARED src/dllmain.cpp src/hook.cpp src/remade.cpp src/pack_probe.cpp src/frame_counter.cpp
    src/game/os_file.cpp $<TARGET_OBJECTS:recomp>)
set_target_properties(usm_re PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX ".asi")
target_include_directories(usm_re PRIVATE src/recomp src/recomp/gen)
# Static runtime so nothing extra has to sit next to USM.exe.
target_link_options(usm_re PRIVATE -static)
target_link_libraries(usm_re PRIVATE winmm)  # timeBeginPeriod for the profiler

# Standalone PC build: USM.exe's code is never executed, only its recompiled translation (src/pc/main.c).
# Lives in the game folder next to USM.exe. The image base keeps 0x400000 free for the mapped game, the big
# stack is shared with the translated code's host stack (rt.c), and nxcompat turns on DEP for the coverage gate.
add_executable(usm_pc src/pc/main.c src/pc/census.c $<TARGET_OBJECTS:recomp>)
target_include_directories(usm_pc PRIVATE src/recomp src/recomp/gen)
target_compile_options(usm_pc PRIVATE -std=gnu11 -w)
target_link_options(usm_pc PRIVATE -static -Wl,--image-base,0x10000000 -Wl,--stack,0x800000 -Wl,--nxcompat)
